basis: NF-Y subunit specifically expressed in the aleurone of developing endosperm; RNAi slows grain filling and gives chalky endosperm (Xu et al. 2016 J Exp Bot). Cited as an aleurone marker by Jing 2026 (ZH02G34290; Stereo-seq aleurone domain). Not in the Liu 2026 panel. Symbol trap: the adjacent locus Os02g0725700 is OsLEC1/NF-YB7.

Sucrose/H+ symporter; in situ on the aleurone periphery at 3-7 DAP (Liu et al. 2026 JIPB, cluster C6). Also expressed in scutellar epithelium at germination and in phloem companion cells (same gene is the Phloem row of rice_root.tsv), so not aleurone-specific across the plant.

Putative anthranilate N-hydroxycinnamoyl/benzoyltransferase; promoter-GUS active only in the dorsal aleurone over the main vascular bundle, the transfer-cell region (Kuwano et al. 2011 Plant Mol Biol). Aleurone panel marker in Liu 2026 (C6, Os01g0382200) and aleurone marker in Jing 2026 (ZH01G18610: same gene length 4,174 bp, matching position). Marks the dorsal aleurone only. No MSU7 ID found (not in Oryzabase or UniProt cross-references): map with --id-column alt_id.
AP2/ERF factor that binds OsNF-YB1 (Xu et al. 2016 J Exp Bot); aleurone Stereo-seq domain marker in Jing 2026 (ZH08G25140; square bins, not cell resolution).

Granule-bound starch synthase I, makes amylose in endosperm starch (waxy mutant). Starchy-endosperm panel marker in Liu 2026 and DE (log2FC 2.0) in the Wang 2025 seed cluster published as 'Plumule', which this review relabels starchy endosperm. Two independent snRNA datasets. Also expressed in pollen and, weakly, in pericarp.

Soluble starch synthase IIIa; flo5 mutant has floury endosperm. Starchy-endosperm panel marker in Liu 2026 and DE (log2FC 1.1) in the Wang 2025 'Plumule' cluster (relabelled starchy endosperm). Two datasets.

Seed bZIP that activates storage-protein and starch genes in endosperm (FLO27). Starchy-endosperm panel marker in Liu 2026 and DE (log2FC 1.9) in the Wang 2025 'Plumule' cluster (relabelled starchy endosperm). Two datasets.

Prolamin-box binding Dof factor that activates storage-protein genes with RISBZ1. Starchy-endosperm panel marker in Liu 2026 and DE (log2FC 1.2) in the Wang 2025 'Plumule' cluster (relabelled starchy endosperm). May also be expressed in aleurone (not re-checked).
Isoamylase 1 for amylopectin synthesis (sugary-1 endosperm). Jing 2026 Stereo-seq marker of the dorsal peripheral endosperm (ZH08G25090), so expect a dorsal bias.

Cytosolic pyruvate orthophosphate dikinase; flo4 floury endosperm; promoter-GUS endosperm-only (Qu and Takaiwa 2004 Plant Biotechnol J, as cited in the Wang 2025 review). Top DE gene (log2FC 1.0) of the Wang 2025 cluster published as 'Scutellum', relabelled endosperm.
NAC factor (UniProt NAC23/OsNAC6). Starchy-endosperm panel marker in Liu 2026 and DE (log2FC 0.64) in the Wang 2025 'Scutellum' cluster (relabelled endosperm). Two datasets, enrichment only.

RING-H2 finger protein (uncharacterized for seed). Jing 2026 Stereo-seq starchy-endosperm domain marker (ZH05G00180) and DE (log2FC 2.0) in the Wang 2025 'Plumule' cluster (relabelled starchy endosperm). Two datasets.
Alanine aminotransferase; floury-endosperm mutant. Starchy-endosperm panel marker in Liu 2026 only.
Seed-specific Ca2+-dependent protein kinase. Starchy-endosperm panel marker in Liu 2026 only.
Endosperm NAC that regulates storage protein and starch with ONAC026 (literature not re-read). DE log2FC 0.6 in the Wang 2025 'Scutellum' cluster (relabelled endosperm).
Endosperm NAC partner of ONAC020 (FLO25; literature not re-read). DE log2FC 0.4 in the Wang 2025 'Plumule' cluster (relabelled starchy endosperm).
TPR protein; flo2 floury endosperm (literature not re-read). DE log2FC 1.3 in the Wang 2025 'Plumule' cluster (relabelled starchy endosperm).
Amyloplast ADP-glucose transporter (BRITTLE1; literature not re-read). DE log2FC 1.0 in the Wang 2025 'Plumule' cluster (relabelled starchy endosperm).

Glutelin A1 storage protein; glutelin promoters are most active in peripheral (subaleurone) endosperm (Qu and Takaiwa 2004, as cited). DE log2FC 0.45 in Wang 2025 'Scutellum' cluster. Storage-protein mRNA is extremely abundant and leaks as ambient RNA into every droplet: use only with z-scores, never presence.

Phi glutathione S-transferase (Oryzabase: endosperm-specific gene 7); in situ in the endosperm adjacent to the scutellum (Jing 2026 portal, marker_resource 'in-situ validation'; ZH01G18290). Endosperm side of the interface.

Sugar transporter. Stereo-seq domain of endosperm adjacent to scutellum (Jing 2026, ZH11G16520) and panel marker of the embryo-endosperm interface cluster C19 (Liu 2026); in situ at the interface reported in Wang et al. 2025 Nat Commun (as cited in the Liu review; not read). Two datasets, raised from low.

MOTHER OF FT AND TFL1 homolog; in situ in cluster C19 at the interface (Liu 2026). Caution: also DE (log2FC 1.7) in the Wang 2025 'Plumule' cluster (relabelled starchy endosperm), so expression may extend into the starchy endosperm at 14 DAF.

GIANT EMBRYO cytochrome P450 that balances embryo and endosperm size; interface panel marker in Liu 2026 (C19); interface in situ in Nagasawa et al. 2013 and Wang et al. 2025 Nat Commun (as cited in the Liu review; not read here).

CCCH zinc finger that represses GluB-1; expressed in a confined domain surrounding the scutellum (Chen et al. 2014 Plant Mol Biol). Conflict: Liu 2026 lists it as an aleurone (C6) panel marker; Wang 2025 used it to call 'Scutellum' but it is not DE there.
WUSCHEL-related homeobox (DWARF TILLER1). Panel marker of interface cluster C19 in Liu 2026 only, no validation.

Auxin response factor; Stereo-seq domain of endosperm adjacent to scutellum (Jing 2026, ZH01G10490). Symbol trap: the portal calls it 'OsARF1', but the chr1 locus is ARF16 (Oryzabase), not Os11g0523800.

GA-induced alpha-amylase secreted by the scutellar epithelium during germination (classic; literature not re-read). DE marker of Jing 2026 germination Scutellum_epidermis (ZH02G37350). Germination stage only. The portal gives the same symbol to the tandem copy ZH02G37370, so the ZH-RAP pairing is uncertain.
Alpha-amylase isozyme 3E; DE marker of Jing 2026 Scutellum_epidermis_1 (ZH08G21650). Germination stage.
Brassinosteroid C6-oxidase (CYP85A1); in situ in scutellum clusters C3/C20 (Liu 2026).
Beta-1,3-glucanase (Oryzabase GNS1); in situ in scutellum clusters C1/C3 (Liu 2026).
YABBY factor; scutellum panel marker in Liu 2026 only, no validation.
Defensin-like protein; Stereo-seq Scutellum_1 domain marker in Jing 2026 (ZH02G27590) only.

Tryptophan aminotransferase for auxin synthesis; in situ and promoter-GUS in the embryonic axis (cluster C7) and fib mutant embryo defect (Liu 2026). Jing 2026 lists it for Stereo-seq Vascular_cell_V (ZH01G05600). Liu C7 also carries maternal vascular-trace genes (GIF1, SWEET11b, CCR14), so check that the cluster is embryonic.
Shoot gravitropism regulator; DE marker of Jing 2026 Coleoptile_2 (ZH11G16030) only.
BODYGUARD homolog (cuticle formation, epidermis-specific in Arabidopsis); in situ and promoter-GUS on the embryo surface (cluster C9, published 'Em-2'; Liu 2026).

HD-GL2 (HD-ZIP IV) homeobox; in situ uniform in globular embryo, then protoderm-preferential at 3-6 DAP, also in integument and endosperm (Yang et al. 2002 Plant Cell Physiol). Jing 2026 filed it under Aleurone (ZH01G38260): conflict.

LEAFY COTYLEDON1-type NF-YB, embryo identity (Arabidopsis LEC1 function; rice gene in Oryzabase as LEC1/HAP3E). DE in Jing 2026 Embryo_unknown_1 (ZH02G34280). Symbol trap: adjacent locus Os02g0725900 is OsNF-YB1 (aleurone).

Uncharacterized (Oryzabase 'endosperm-specific gene 115'); in situ in embryo cluster C15 (Liu 2026, where it is mislabelled 'glutelin') and DE (log2FC 1.6) in the Wang 2025 seed 'unknown' cluster (embryo/aleurone maturation). Not raised: the Wang cluster identity is unresolved. Name conflict with 'endosperm-specific'.

16 kDa oleosin (oil bodies); oleosin promoters are active in embryo and aleurone (Qu and Takaiwa 2004, as cited). DE in the Wang 2025 seed 'unknown' cluster. Marks embryo and aleurone together; use to separate them from starchy endosperm.
18 kDa oleosin; promoter-GUS in embryo and aleurone (Qu and Takaiwa 2004, as cited). DE in the Wang 2025 seed 'unknown' cluster. Embryo and aleurone together.
ABA-induced embryonic abundant LEA protein; DE (log2FC 1.8) in the Wang 2025 seed 'unknown' cluster. Maturation stage; aleurone may share it.

Sucrose efflux transporter needed for grain filling; GUS/protein in ovular vascular trace, nucellar epidermis, nucellar projection and cross cells (Ma et al. 2017 Plant Cell Physiol; Yang et al. 2018 New Phytol). Marker in three datasets: Liu 2026 nucellus (C17/C18), Jing 2026 Inner_Pericarp-Testa_2 domain (ZH08G26300), Wang 2025 'Vascular' cluster (log2FC 2.4). Also in aleurone and cross cells: a maternal sugar-unloading marker rather than a single cell type.
Sucrose efflux transporter; protein in nucellus (early), nucellar projection, nucellar epidermis and aleurone (Yang et al. 2018 New Phytol). Nucellus panel marker in Liu 2026.

Seed-specific MADS factor required for programmed cell death of nucellar tissue (as summarized in Khurana et al. 2022 Front Plant Sci; original Yin and Xue 2012 not re-read). Nucellus panel marker in Liu 2026.
Nucellin-like aspartic protease (UniProt); Stereo-seq nucellus domain marker at 1-3 DAP in Jing 2026 (ZH11G06280).
Vacuolar processing enzyme (PCD-associated protease); nucellus panel marker in Liu 2026. Jing 2026 lists it for 'Blank' bins (ZH05G32550): weak conflict.
GA-deactivating P450 (ELONGATED UPPERMOST INTERNODE1); nucellus panel marker in Liu 2026 only.

Cell-wall invertase required for early grain filling (Wang et al. 2008 Nat Genet). Jing 2026 cites it for Stereo-seq Vascular_cell_I (ZH04G13530). Conflict: Liu 2026 lists it in the embryonic-axis panel (C7). Localization in the vascular trace taken from Jing's citation, not re-read.
GA 2-oxidase; Jing 2026 Stereo-seq Vascular_cell_I domain marker (ZH01G36020) and DE (log2FC 2.3) in the Wang 2025 seed 'Vascular' cluster. Two datasets, raised from low.

AGAMOUS-clade MADS factor; DE in Jing 2026 Vascular_cell_2 (ZH01G45070, matched by portal symbol) and Wang 2025 seed 'Vascular' cluster (log2FC 2.5). Two datasets, raised from low. Ovule-derived maternal tissue; vascular-trace vs nucellar-projection not resolved.
Cinnamoyl-CoA reductase (lignin); DE (log2FC 2.5) in the Wang 2025 seed 'Vascular' cluster. Liu 2026 lists it in the embryonic-axis panel (C7): conflict.
Clade III SWEET; second-ranked DE gene (log2FC 3.5) of the Wang 2025 seed 'Vascular' cluster. Conflict: Liu 2026 lists it in the embryonic-axis panel (C7).

HAD-like hydrolase (uncharacterized); in situ near the dorsal vascular bundle (Wang 2025 ED Fig 2h) and top DE gene of its seed 'Vascular' cluster. Same locus is a root Pericycle marker in rice_root.tsv (Os07g0634400): a vascular-associated gene, not seed-specific.

Hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase (DRIPPING-WET LEAF7, cuticle); promoter-GUS in cluster C10 (Liu 2026). Liu published C10 as 'ventral aleurone', but all its panel genes are cuticle/wax genes; this review reads it as a cuticle-forming seed coat (testa) or epidermal layer.
GDSL esterase/lipase; in situ marks a thin peripheral layer (cluster C10; Liu 2026). Same caveat as OsHSD1 (published 'ventral aleurone').
3-ketoacyl-CoA synthase for very-long-chain fatty acids (ONION1, cuticle); C10 panel marker (Liu 2026). Published 'ventral aleurone'.
Very-long-chain aldehyde decarbonylase (wax); C10 panel marker (Liu 2026). Published 'ventral aleurone'.

Germin-like protein; Jing 2026 Stereo-seq Outer_Pericarp-Testa_3 domain (ZH08G06460) and DE (log2FC 1.9) in the Wang 2025 seed 'Epidermis' cluster (outer maternal layer). Two datasets, raised from low. Also DE in Wang 'Vascular' (1.4).

Light-harvesting chlorophyll a/b protein. Jing 2026 Pericarp-Testa domain at 1-3 DAP (ZH08G19490, matched by symbol and position) and Liu 2026 pericarp panel (C2). Two datasets. Photosynthesis gene: marks the green cross-cell/chlorenchyma layer, the only green tissue in the caryopsis; hull or leaf contamination will also express it.
Mg-chelatase H subunit (chlorophyll synthesis); Liu 2026 pericarp panel (C2). Photosynthesis gene: same caveat as DYE1.

Oryzacystatin I; in situ on the outer layer of the grain (Wang 2025 Fig 1f), but the sense control also stains the surface; top DE gene of the Wang 'Epidermis' cluster. Which outer layer (pericarp epidermis, seed coat or hull) is not stated.
G2/M cyclin. Jing 2026 Stereo-seq marker of 'Cellularized_endosperm' (ZH01G39270), a proliferation state labelled as a type. Same row as rice_root.tsv Dividing_cells.
Cytokinesis-specific syntaxin (G2/M). Jing 2026 'Cellularized_endosperm' marker (ZH03G35610).
APC/C activator of mitosis (G2/M). Jing 2026 'Cellularized_endosperm' marker (ZH02G32250; portal symbol OsWD40-51|OsCDC20.1; matched by symbol and position).
